checks.name: MinIO object store
checks.detail: HeadBucket failed: connection refused to the configured S3 endpoint
checks.remedy:
MinIO is not reachable at the configured S3_ENDPOINT_URL.

  1. Check it's running:   docker ps | grep minio
  2. Start it:             tools/setup-warehouse-server.sh (or your usual compose up)
  3. Confirm the endpoint: grep S3_ENDPOINT_URL .env
  4. Retry the probe:     curl -sf "$S3_ENDPOINT_URL/minio/health/live"

Until this is fixed, the raw-delivery inventory on Catalog and Overview cannot verify
any checksum — it will show every object as unverified, not just the ones affected.

checks.name: Parquet read-store
checks.detail: opened 2/4 shard files; lane 3 R1 and lane 4 R2 failed to parse
checks.remedy:
Two of four read-store shards did not open cleanly.

  1. Rebuild the missing shards: uv run mva-reads-api rebuild-store --lane 3,4
  2. Check disk space first:    df -h $(dirname "$READ_STORE_PATH")
  3. Inspect a bad shard directly: parquet-tools inspect <path-to-shard>

The Reads page will render with the 2 healthy shards and flag which lanes are missing
from the flowcell heatmap and per-cycle quality curves.

checks.name: Raw-reads API
checks.remedy:
The raw-reads API is not running.

  1. Start it, from the repo root: uv run mva-reads-api
  2. Verify it answers:            curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:8765/health
  3. The viz API proxies to it — no restart needed once it is back.

Until this is fixed, Probes returns 503 and Reads shows a start-command card instead
of an error for the routes that need it.

checks.name: Ensembl REST
checks.remedy:
Ensembl's public REST API is slow or rate-limiting us right now.

  1. Check their status page: https://rest.ensembl.org (or status.ensembl.org)
  2. Gene-structure lookups are disk-cached after the first fetch, so this only slows
     down genes nobody has opened yet this session.
  3. If it persists past a few minutes, wait — there is no local mirror to fail over to.

checks.name: ClinVar local snapshot
checks.detail: CLINVAR_SNAPSHOT_PATH not set — not configured, this is optional
checks.remedy:
Optional performance path, not required for correctness.

  1. To enable it: set CLINVAR_SNAPSHOT_PATH in the repo-root .env to a local VCF mirror.
  2. Without it, /api/panel/clinvar-presence joins against the live ClinVar table on
     every request instead of a pre-loaded snapshot — slower, not wrong.
